bundles.concept: OAuth, linked identity, recovery, consolidation, and ranked identity
bundles.authority_model: OAuth proves control of one configured provider subject; ranked identity and human-uniqueness resolution remain separate server authorities.
bundles.transaction_boundary: OAuth transaction creation, callback consumption, provider binding, linked-identity mutation, session effects, audit, and idempotent result commit atomically where coupled.

bundles.concept: Daemon, shell, collector, sync, local IPC, and supervision
bundles.authority_model: OS peer identity and daemon-issued capabilities determine local roles; message payloads never self-assign trust.
bundles.transaction_boundary: Handshake, generation, capability grant, replay window, command effect, audit, and revocation use explicit boundaries per trust domain.

bundles.concept: Adapter compatibility, certification, source evidence, and accounting
bundles.authority_model: Only an active non-expired certification for one exact artifact/source/version/mode/platform/accounting tuple can authorize competitive capture; provider receipts or server retrieval are required for source-bound evidence.
bundles.transaction_boundary: Tuple resolution precedes normalization; deduplication, checked accounting, evidence bundle creation, appraisal, and ranking contribution retain exact immutable inputs.
bundles.implementation_owner: Rust adapter/accounting and Go appraisal work units after P-1104
prohibited_authority: generic ACP or OTel competitive eligibility

bundles.concept: Ranking, periods, generations, contributions, corrections, and authorization
bundles.authority_model: Server-owned immutable appraisals and contribution records feed immutable ranking generations; viewer-relative scopes require current authorization at display time.
bundles.transaction_boundary: Contribution acceptance, generation build, active-pointer promotion, snapshot cursor creation, correction, and retraction have explicit isolated transactions.
bundles.implementation_owner: Go ranking work units after P-1104
prohibited_authority: friends or board view without current viewer authorization

bundles.concept: Social relationships, boards, presence, notifications, moderation, and appeals
bundles.authority_model: Friendship, directional blocks, rivalry, membership, roles, ownership, presence, inbox items, delivery attempts, moderation, and appeals are separate authorities.
bundles.transaction_boundary: Each relationship or board mutation commits effect, generation/revision, audit, notification source event, and idempotent result atomically where coupled.

bundles.transaction_boundary: Business effect, audit, outbox, exact response, export snapshot, deletion effects, release promotion, migration and rollback each define durable atomic or recoverable boundaries.
